description: Prepare an import of the user's past net worth: one total per date, from old statements or another tracker's export. Saves a draft only. Nothing is added until the user reviews and imports it in Krosos, so this works on a read-only connection. total_value_eur is the whole net worth that day in base_currency (the field name is historical): convert first; it may be negative. A date that already has a figure is replaced when imported.
name: propose_net_worth_history_import
title: Propose net worth history import
